title: Stepped-Hull Pylon-Engine Flying Boat
description: One original static low-poly flying-boat exterior, newly authored as a continuous closed boat-bottom fuselage with narrow finite keel sole, real chines and a raised aft bottom step; opaque cockpit material belongs to the hull surface. One complete thick high main wing on a hull pedestal, a distinct above-wing engine pylon with nacelle and fixed two-blade propeller, two complete underwing outrigger floats with paired struts, wing braces, a swept dorsal fin and low horizontal tail. Seventeen complete closed connected-by-overlap components; no old aircraft or boat geometry imported, no scaled wing or wheel-count variant. One whole vehicle prop, source Z-up metres, ground datum at the hull keel. Pose is a dry static visual display, not a deployed landing-gear or flotation simulation. No moving controls, open cabin, wheel system, textures, pilots or fuel lines. No flight, buoyancy, propulsion, aerodynamics, functional sampling, production engineering or aviation safety claim.
